neighbours.label: health advice about routine medical care: the slot before 'regular checkup', 'prenatal visit', 'eye exam', 'health screening'
fire: Ask your doctor at what age your child should have a first hearing test.
When was the last time you saw your dentist for a cleaning?
Be sure to keep all of your prenatal appointments with your midwife.
Women should also see a gynecologist every year.
Visit your doctor for regular checkups and blood tests.
Make time for your annual physical with your family doctor.
Schedule a routine eye exam at least once every two years.
Older adults should keep an eye on their blood pressure.
quiet: Ask your coach at what age your child should join a first soccer team.
When was the last time you saw your cousin at a wedding?
Be sure to keep all of your tax receipts with your records.
Women should also vote in the election every year.
Visit your grandmother for long lunches and card games.
Make time for your morning coffee with your old friend.
Schedule a weekend road trip at least once every two years.
Older adults should keep an eye on their savings accounts.

notes: The card's output direction: the + pole suppresses ' check', ' visits', ' appointments', ' annual', ' routine', ' regular', so this - pole promotes them.
